title: Delicious and Fun!
text: The experience of cooking Paella and Crema Catalana was delicious and fun! Highly recommend! The Cheff was so friendly and made the preparation easy and enjoyable 👍
author: E3611ZJarmandos

title: A fun, welcoming cooking class with clear guidance from  Chef Juan
text: Great experience and lovely people! The cooking class was amazing from start to finish. Chef Juan was incredibly funny and explained everything clearly, paying attention to every detail. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and I absolutely loved the idea behind the social impact of this place. Cooking while supporting such a meaningful project made the experience even more special. Highly recommended!
author: dariabR3676WO

title: Great family kitchen plan and social impact
text: A great experience with a touch of social impact. We learned how to make Gazpacho, made a brothy rice with butifarras and prepared a real Catalan cream. All within the kitchen of a restaurant in which they develop a great social project in which they prepare people to work in hospitality. Very well served by Juan, our cook and the Mescladis team.
author: albertoo507

title: Perfect!
text:
It was amazing, Diana was super nice and the food super tasty!
We cooked gaspacho, paella and then crema catalana! We also had water and sangria for free🥰
author: N8632GHmarionb

title: Wonderful
text: We had a wonderful time learning to cook with Diana!! The explanations were crystal clear, the cooking was easy and obviously the food was wonderful. It was a lot of fun and a very relaxed environment. I really recommend the experience
author: NoOrdinaryLou

title: İncreible
text: The class with Diana was great: we learned a lot, had fun all the time and the dishes we prepared were amazing. His way of teaching is clear, patient and super motivating. An experience I would repeat without hesitation!
author: 298s_l_nec

title: A wonderful cooking journey!
text: This was so much fun! Diana is such a helpful, kind, and informative instructor. The food was so tasty, and we got to cook and try 3 different dishes and cooking techniques. I thoroughly recommend this experience!
author: nikelleh2025

title: Would recommend 100%
text: It was such a good moment with my friends and the food tasted so good! I had a great time and will recommend it to everyone that want to have fun and eat typical Catalan food.
author: clairefH6155BJ

title: Amazing interactive culinary experience
text: Diana was our guide. She explained everything very clearly and told us a lot about the history and culture of the dishes we are making and about Catalonia. She was very patient and guides us during preparation. The meal was absolutely delicious! The restaurant is very cute.

title: Great experience
